# Stefan McFeeters and SM Systems

Stefan McFeeters is an automation and integration developer based in Melbourne, Australia. He designs and builds AI support systems, APIs, workflow automation, CRM operations, websites, data systems, and connected operator tools.

## Flagship projects

- Zendesk AI Support Copilot with Jira on AWS: https://smsystems.au/work/zendesk-ai-support-copilot/
- Automation Debugger: https://smsystems.au/work/automation-debugger/
- Conversion Measurement and Inbound Lead System: https://smsystems.au/work/conversion-measurement-inbound-lead-system/
- Precision Residential Construction Website: https://smsystems.au/work/precision-residential-construction/
